object.attr: analysis: review Q26. Commit, review, then issue is the usual flow, and today it needs a fake change or an agent. Answered on 2026-11-11: should, to confirm. MELLON-VER-SRS-281 guards against a latest commit that moved, and MELLON-VER-SRS-249 against an invalid document. Replaces MELLON-VER-SRS-261.
object.description: While the open document has no uncommitted change, the commit dialog should let the user raise the issue and tag the latest commit as that issue without a new commit.
